key_points: PepsiCo trading near 52‑week low; concerns about North American snack volume weakness.
International segment showing faster growth and higher margins, cited as a potential offset.

A speculative headline about a "major shutdown" at PepsiCo adds short‑term uncertainty but lacks concrete detail.
